method: Every real-data candidate that CLIP did not call clearly outdoor (indoor probability > 0.3; 287 scenarios) was looked at by eye on its current image and labelled indoor or outdoor. Courtyards, covered walkways and arcades open to the outside count as outdoor. Simulated (HSSD) candidates need CLIP indoor probability >= 0.95 (gardens around the houses score 0.3-0.5) and are inspected in the final audit. Simulated scenarios whose current image has more than 15% near-black pixels in its top 40% are excluded as exteriors (no ceiling mesh above gardens; calibrated on 16 audited scenarios: catches 6 of 7 exteriors, drops 1 of 9 interiors). Every selected scenario was inspected on its audit image (current image with the recorded path, bird's-eye view with obstacles, people, reference path, goal and baselines); scenarios that passed are listed under `accepted` and kept fixed when the selection is re-run, so only replacements need review. Candidates whose view nearly matches a rejected scenario of the same house or recording (CLIP similarity > 0.94) are excluded too. v2 keeps v1's accepted real scenarios fixed and replaces simulated indoor scenarios by real indoor walks from MuSoHu wherever the constraints allow. MuSoHu: 494 valid candidates not clearly outdoor by CLIP were labelled by eye (glass atria count as indoor, courtyards and covered walkways outside as outdoor).
